scenes.setting: Kneeling over the body in the club hall: Spirit Vision shows black gas coiled like a snake around Talim's heart — a curse, not a heart attack — and Klein leaves the corpse untouched, sending for police and letting officialdom investigate rather than playing lone hero
scenes.text_anchor: A Beyonder ability similar to a curse?

scenes.setting: Back to the Lucky Bar's billiard room: a cursed believer of the Lord of Storms in Hillston Borough falls outside the Machinery Hivemind's remit, so Carlson will only pass it on; walking home past the darkened Sammer house, grief and anger settle in
scenes.text_anchor: “We have no right to take the case. This is under the Mandated Punishers.

scenes.setting: The Tussock Times calls it 'sudden heart disease' with a funeral on the 21st; Stanton, asked whether the Mandated Punishers are baiting the killer, makes inquiries — and by evening sends one line: the case was taken by the royal family, on the grounds that Talim was a noble
scenes.text_anchor: “The royal family has taken the case by claiming that Talim Dumont is a noble.”
